verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's feature-status and ingestion docs say materialized views (incremental, insert-triggered transformations) and refreshable materialized views work inside the platform, including over Kafka table engine ingestion. Batch SQL tasks and CHKit 'pipelines as code' add adjacent support. This is direct support, but coverage is only partial because the evidence consists of single-line feature-list mentions. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of continuous/incremental transformation behavior on the compute–storage-separated architecture (e.g., MV semantics, refresh scheduling, failure/retry handling), clarity on whether CHKit pipelines execute in-platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run continuous or incremental transformations — streams, tasks, declarative pipelines, or continuous queries — inside the platform
